Verification Record

Verification record using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

verification_record(command, status, artifact)

Example input

{
  "command": "python -m unittest",
  "status": "PASS",
  "artifact": "test-output.txt"
}

Example output

{
  "command": "python -m unittest",
  "status": "PASS",
  "artifact": "test-output.txt"
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py verification_record < examples/verification-record.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
